docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-19-2015 - JUDGMENT AFTER THE COURT GRANTING THE PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST TO CORRECT OR CANCEL JUDGMENT AND ANSWER OF JANUARY 6, 2015.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GROVES, DAVID RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LEE, NORBERT $799.00 PRINCIPAL, $110.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $909.00, DEFENDANT'S RESPONSE TO THE REQUEST TO CORRECT JUDGMENT INCLUDES THE COPY OF A CASHIERS' CHECK MADE PAYABLE TO LYNN RICHARDSON IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,656.00. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT
(SC-108) REQUEST TO CORRECT OR CANCEL JUDGMENT AND ANSWER FILED BY PLAINTIFF GROVES, DAVID
ORDER GRANTING REQUEST TO CORRECT THE JUDGMENT. 3/27/15 ORDER IS RESCINDED AND JUDGMENT IS AMENDED TO REFLECT AN AWARD OF $2,455.00 (PLUS $110.00 IN COSTS) TO PLAINTIFF

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING AMENDED JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GROVES, DAVID RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LEE, NORBERT $2,455.00 PRINCIPAL, $110.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,565.00, GRANTING REQUEST TO CORRECT THE JUDGMENT. 3/27/15 ORDER IS RESCINDED AND JUDGMENT IS AMENDED TO REFLECT AN AWARD OF $2,455.00 (PLUS $110.00 IN COSTS) TO PLAINTIFF.
